metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Quadratus Lumborum Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve quadratus lumborum muscle tightness and pain.

The quadratus lumborum, commonly called the QL muscle, is a common cause pain in the lower back and hips, especially off to one side. 

What causes this is tightness and weakness. To quickly fix this this, the video will be broken up into three separate parts, with each focusing on a different way to target the QL muscle. 

To get the best results, make sure to go through all parts (and exercises) and use what offers you the most relief. 

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home and may give quick pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and get rid of quadratus lumborum for good!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:07 QL Muscle Release
3:55 90-90 QL Opener (Stretch)
5:34 Ballerina (Stretch)
6:51 Hip Hiker (Strengthening) 
8:30 Butt Walk (Strengthening)
